instructions:
Choose the correct letter, A, B, C or D.
Write the correct letter in boxes 32 and 33 on your answer sheet.

Choose TWO letters, A-G.
Write the correct letters in boxes 34 and 35 on your answer sheet.

items.prompt: What did the dataset the researchers analysed cover?

options.text: All of the company's departments, across a single year
One department, from the company's founding up to 2023
One department, across a period of twelve months
All of the company's departments, across two years

items.evidence: A team of researchers analysed 977 employee-month records from one of the company's departments, covering April 2022 through March 2023.

distractor_analysis.A: Kapsam kaydirma -- 977 kayitlik bir veri kumesi ve 900 kisilik bir sirket duyulunca sezgi dogrudan sirketin tamamina gidiyor; oysa B/1 kayitlarin 'one of the company's departments' ten alindigini soyluyor.
distractor_analysis.B: Cazip ama yok -- sirketin bastan uzaktan kuruldugu A/3'te anlatiliyor, ama veri kumesi kurulustan itibaren degil, belirli bir on iki ayi kapsiyor.
distractor_analysis.D: Kapsam kaydirma -- iki yanlisi birlestiriyor: hem butun departmanlar hem iki yil. Nisan 2022 - Mart 2023 araligi tek bir yil.

items.explanation: Paragraph B says the researchers analysed 977 employee-month records from one of the company's departments, covering April 2022 through March 2023.

revision.onceki_prompt: What did combining the three sets of records allow the researchers to do?

onceki_secenekler.A: Follow employees as they moved between departments
onceki_secenekler.B: See each person's output alongside who their teammates were
onceki_secenekler.C: Check company figures against what staff reported themselves
onceki_secenekler.D: Cover a longer period than one source alone

revision.ne_degisti: Dogru secenek kanit cumlesinin sozcuklerinden uzaklastirildi ('see... how much each employee produced, but who they were working alongside' -> 'set an individual's output beside the teammates around them'). Soru koku de 'neden birlestirildi' bicimine cekilip dort secenek ayni amac kalibina ('To ...') getirildi; boylece dogru secenegi kanit cumlesinin yankisi olmasindan taniyan kestirme kapandi.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Why did the researchers combine three separate sets of records?
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Combining these three sources let the researchers see not only how much each employee produced, but who they were working alongside and how often they exchanged messages with teammates in a given month.

eski_secenekler.A: To follow employees as they moved between departments
eski_secenekler.B: To set an individual's output beside the teammates around them
eski_secenekler.C: To check the company's own figures against what staff reported
eski_secenekler.D: To stretch the study over more months than one source covered

yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Soru uc kaydin nicin birlestirildigini soruyordu; calismanin konusu akran etkisi oldugu icin 'kisinin ciktisini yanindakilerle yan yana koymak' seceneklerden salt mantikla cikiyordu (E7 3/3, dayanak logic).
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Kanit B/4'ten B/1'e alindi ve soru amactan kapsama cevrildi: veri kumesinin hangi birimi ve hangi sureyi kapsadigi disaridan bilinemez. Sezgi YANLIS secenege capali: 900 calisanli bir sirkette yapilan calisma denince akla sirketin tamami geliyor, metin ise tek bir departman diyor.

items.prompt: Which employees does the passage say did best where internal messaging was least frequent?

options.text: Those who had joined the company most recently
Those who were already experienced or highly productive
Those who were serving the largest number of clients
Those whose teams had the shortest average service

items.evidence: In fact, teams with the highest average tenure communicated internally less than other teams, a statistically significant difference, and experienced or already highly productive employees tended to perform best in exactly these lower-communication settings, suggesting that frequent messaging may sometimes distract rather than assist workers who already know what they are doing.

distractor_analysis.A: Yer degistirme -- yeni calisanlar F/2'nin konusu: deneyimli takimlarin yaninda en cok onlar kazaniyor. Metnin butun savi yeni gelenin yardima ihtiyaci oldugu yonunde oldugu icin 'az mesajlasma onlara yariyor' sezgisel duruyor, ama G/2 tam tersini, zaten isini bilenleri isaret ediyor.
distractor_analysis.C: Kapsam kaydirma -- hizmet verilen musteri sayisi D/1'de ciktinin OLCUSU olarak taniniyor, dusuk iletisimli ortamda kimin iyi is cikardigina dair bir ayrim degil.
distractor_analysis.D: Ters cevirme -- G/2 en az mesajlasan takimlarin en UZUN ortalama kidemli takimlar oldugunu soyluyor; en kisa kidemli takimlar degil.

items.explanation: Paragraph G says experienced or already highly productive employees tended to perform best in exactly these lower-communication settings.

revision.onceki_prompt: What did the finding on internal messaging call into question?

onceki_secenekler.A: The claim that messaging can be measured at all
onceki_secenekler.B: The finding that new staff gain from experience
onceki_secenekler.C: The rule that teams are formed by joining order
onceki_secenekler.D: The idea that experienced teams communicate more

revision.ne_degisti: Eski A ('mesajlasmanin olculebilirligi') anlamca sacma oldugu icin parcasiz eleniyordu ve geri kalan iki celdirici de pasajin acikca dogruladigi seyleri hedef gosteriyordu. Dort secenek de artik metnin gercekten kurdugu birer iddia (F/2 yeni calisanlarin kazanci, C/1 rastgele takim kurulusu, D/1-2 cikti olcusu, G/1 deneyim-iletisim bagi) ve hepsi 'sorgulanabilir' cercevede; ayirt etme G/1'i okumaya bagli. Dogru secenek de kanit cumlesinin sozcuklerinden uzaklastirildi.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: What did the finding on internal messaging call into question?
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: A further finding complicated the obvious explanation that experienced teams simply talk to one another more.

eski_secenekler.A: The finding that newcomers gain most from experienced teammates
eski_secenekler.B: The claim that team membership was decided at random
eski_secenekler.C: The measure chosen to judge how much work each person did
eski_secenekler.D: The assumption that longer-serving teams keep in touch more often

yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Soru 'mesajlasma bulgusu neyi sorgulatti' diye soruyordu ve dort secenekten yalniz biri iletisimle ilgiliydi; konu esleşmesi tek basina cevabi veriyordu (E7 3/3, dayanak logic).
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Kanit G/1'den G/2'ye alindi ve soru 'hangi varsayim sarsildi' yerine 'kim daha iyi is cikardi' bicimine getirildi; dort secenek de artik ayni turden (calisan kumesi), yani konu esleşmesi ayirt etmiyor. Sezgi YANLIS secenege capali: metnin ana savi yeni gelenlerin destege ihtiyaci oldugu yonunde, oysa dusuk iletisimden kazancli cikanlar zaten deneyimli olanlar.

items.prompt: All seven statements below are true of Caster. Which TWO does the passage give as reasons why the example set by high performers has little effect there?

options.text: Staff are spread across all of Japan's prefectures and 23 other countries
New hires are placed in teams in the order in which they joined
Each client contract sets aside a fixed thirty hours of support a month
Employees are paid according to their own output alone
The company sells administrative and secretarial services online
Colleagues never see one another face to face
The researchers combined three separate internal record sources

items.evidence: In an office, visibly high-performing colleagues can motivate others through social comparison and peer pressure, but Caster pays employees according to individual output alone, removing much of the incentive to match a team's overall performance; without face-to-face contact to reinforce that pressure further, it appears to have little effect at all.

distractor_analysis.A: Dogru ama gerekce degil -- A/2 personelin 47 ilin tamamina ve 23 ulkeye yayildigini soyluyor. Cografi dagilim, akran etkisinin yoklugu icin en akla yatkin aciklama gibi duruyor ve F ile dogrudan yarisiyor; ama H/2 gerekce olarak dagilimi degil, yuz yuze temasin bulunmamasini gosteriyor.
distractor_analysis.B: Dogru ama gerekce degil -- katilma sirasina gore takim kurulusu C/1'de calismanin nicin guvenilir sayildigini acikliyor. 'Yildizlar bilerek dagitilmadi' diye okunabildigi icin nedensel goruniyor, oysa pasaj bunu bir gerekce olarak one surmuyor.
distractor_analysis.C: Dogru ama gerekce degil -- her musteri sozlesmesinin sabit otuz saat ayirdigi D/2'de ciktinin nasil olculdugunu savunmak icin veriliyor.
distractor_analysis.E: Dogru ama gerekce degil -- sirketin ne is yaptigi A/1'de taniticidir; akran etkisiyle hicbir baglantisi kurulmuyor.
distractor_analysis.G: Dogru ama gerekce degil -- uc kaynagin birlestirilmesi B/3-4'te bir yontem karari; bulguyu degil, bulguya nasil varildigini anlatiyor.

items.explanation: Paragraph H says that Caster pays employees according to individual output alone, which removes much of the incentive to match a team's overall performance, and that without face-to-face contact to reinforce peer pressure it appears to have little effect at all.

revision.onceki_prompt: Which TWO reasons are given for star colleagues having no effect?

onceki_secenekler.A: Teams were formed by joining order
onceki_secenekler.B: Top performers were scattered across teams
onceki_secenekler.C: Pay reflects each employee's own output
onceki_secenekler.D: New staff were excluded from the analysis
onceki_secenekler.E: Star performers messaged teammates less often
onceki_secenekler.F: Colleagues never meet one another in person
onceki_secenekler.G: Contracts fix the hours each worker gives

revision.ne_degisti: Eskiden yalniz C ve F 'etkinin neden gorunmedigi' cercevesinde yaziliyor, oteki bes secenek baska bir bulguyu ya da yontem ayrintisini anlatiyordu; bu yuzden cerceve tek basina dogru ikiliyi veriyordu. Yedi secenek de yeniden yazilarak ayni cerceveye tasindi -- her biri simdi akran etkisinin yoklugu icin one surulebilecek makul bir aciklama bicimindedir (dagitim, orneklem disi birakma, sabit saat, dusuk mesajlasma, atama duzeni) ve yanlisliklari ancak pasajda nereye ait olduklari gorulunce anlasiliyor.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Which TWO reasons are given for star colleagues having no effect?
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: In an office, visibly high-performing colleagues can motivate others through social comparison and peer pressure, but Caster pays employees according to individual output alone, removing much of the incentive to match a team's overall performance; without face-to-face contact to reinforce that pressure further, it appears to have little effect at all.

eski_secenekler.A: Star performers were spread too thinly across the teams
eski_secenekler.B: Employees' first six months were left out of the figures
eski_secenekler.C: Employees are paid only for what they produce themselves
eski_secenekler.D: Each client contract fixes the hours a worker gives
eski_secenekler.E: Highly productive staff sent fewer messages than others
eski_secenekler.F: Colleagues never see one another face to face
eski_secenekler.G: Teams were formed by joining order rather than by choice

yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Yedi secenegin bir kismi pasajda hic dayanagi olmayan ya da acikca yanlis ifadelerdi; aday once 'hangileri dogru' elemesini yapip kalan iki adayi isaretleyebiliyordu. Ayrica dogru harfler C ve F ile paketin oteki iki keleminin dogru harfleri (B ve D) birlikte duzenli bir dagilim birakiyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Yedi secenegin YEDISI de artik pasajin dogruladigi ifadeler; soru koku de bunu acikca soyluyor. Boylece 'dogru olani bul' elemesi tumuyle kalkti, ayrim yalnizca H/2'nin gerekce olarak neyi gosterdigine kaldi. Secenekler yeniden dagitilarak dogru harfler D ve F yapildi; paketin cevap dizisi artik C, B, D+F, yani ne alfabetik ne duzenli. Ayrica hicbir secenek baska bir AC2 keleminin kanit cumlesine degmiyor (B/2, D/1, F/3, H/4 disarida birakildi).
